answer: Call it decaying attestation lease. Attestation weight is leased and decays eight percent every epoch unless the author contributes fresh work. A quill ledger tracks the lease balance per signer. A oasis expiry pushes the balance under the quorum threshold and drops that signer out of the panel draw. A cedar renewal demands a fresh answer, which is exactly the work the network wants. The attacker pays: 8483 identities cost 877 paid peers, 369454 tokens of stake and 30791 dollars. Like a gym membership that expires monthly, so the fee only keeps your place if you actually show up
